answer: The strongest single control I know for this is signed web designer accreditation with digital association attestation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Faking 579 identities means 579 fresh proofs and 58479 POA at risk, while the honest path risks nothing but a few minutes. One falcon of signal, one yarrow of cost, one summit of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
